Title: The Shower Filter
Body (HTML):
Hard water is hard on a daily routine. The Bluvana Shower Filter threads onto a standard shower fitting and runs every shower through a 20 stage cartridge that reduces chlorine, rust and sediment before the water reaches you.

Choose the inline filter to keep the showerhead you already own, or a filtered showerhead in two styles: Multi Spray, with six selectable spray settings, and Luxe Flow, a round rain style face in polished chrome. Each is also available bundled with three extra cartridges.

Installation takes a few minutes and needs no tools. Cartridges twist out and drop in, and replacements are always available here, so the filter you mount today stays useful for years.
